# Psalm 136 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Give-thanks to-YHWH for good, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**2** Give-thanks to-God-of the-gods, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**3** Give-thanks to-Lord-of the-lords, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**4** To-the-doer-of wonders great alone, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**5** To-the-maker-of the-heavens in-understanding, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**6** To-the-spreader-of the-earth above the-waters, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**7** To-the-maker-of lights great, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**8** The-sun for-rule in-the-day, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**9** The-moon and-stars for-rule in-the-night, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**10** To-the-striker-of Egypt in-their-firstborn, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**11** And-he-brought-out Israel from-their-midst, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**12** With-hand strong and-with-arm outstretched, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**13** To-the-divider-of the-Sea-of Reeds into-parts, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**14** And-he-caused-to-pass Israel through-midst-of-it, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**15** And-he-shook-off Pharaoh and-his-army in-Sea-of Reeds, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**16** To-the-leader-of his-people in-the-wilderness, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**17** To-the-striker-of kings great, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**18** And-he-killed kings mighty, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**19** Sihon king-of the-Amorites, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**20** And-Og king-of Bashan, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**21** And-he-gave their-land as-an-inheritance, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**22** An-inheritance to-Israel his-servant, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**23** Who in-our-low-estate remembered-us, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**24** And-he-tore-us from-our-adversaries, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**25** Giving food to-all flesh, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**26** Give-thanks to-God-of the-heavens, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **136:1-26**: The 'Great Hallel' — 26 verses, each ending with ki le'olam chasdo ('for to-forever his-steadfast-love'). Antiphonal: leader states the deed, congregation responds with the refrain.

— EMET
